annotations.title: Look up a Hawaiʻi parcel in 3D

description: Answers questions about one Hawaiʻi lot, by TMK or street address: what is this parcel zoned and what are the dimensional rules (setbacks, height, lot coverage, density), what the county code lists for adding to the lot (an ADU or a second dwelling), is it in the Special Management Area (SMA), which State Land Use District (Urban, Rural, Agricultural, Conservation), what FEMA flood zone, is it in the tsunami evacuation zone, the 3.2 ft sea level rise flood zone or the Sea Level Rise Constraint District, the wildfire risk, the lava flow hazard zone on Hawaiʻi Island, elevation, slope and aspect, Important Agricultural Lands, soil series and farmland rating, wetlands and streams, historic properties nearby, nearest wells and depth to water, water and sewer service and cesspool records, landslide and dam zones, shoreline setback and vacation rental (TVR) standing on Kauaʻi, tax class and acres. One call returns every finding for the lot, each with its official county, State or federal source, and a permalink to cite. Also a 3D picture of the lot drawn from USGS lidar with the lot line on the ground, and a link to the full sheet. Free: 1 lot a day, 5 a week. Unlimited, with public records, on ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month).

address.description: Or a Hawaiʻi street address, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
